product_contract: Before any Build/Buy mutation that changes a room, story, stairs, floor, wall, or building structure, the host must have an attested Sims My Library save of that building. The library item is the operator's human-judgment revert point. Game Save As (BI_TMP_/BI_CONT_) remains a separate recovery path and does not satisfy this gate. Live raw SendInput that skips admit_live_structure_effect is forbidden. Applies to every host/agent caller — not an optional courtesy.
motivating_corrections: 2026-11-08 operator: agent deleted house walls without first saving the building to the library so the change could be reverted; human judgment must be preserved by host logic before room mutation.

2026-11-09 operator: agents deleted FLOOR_2 / stairs while thrashing around a Medicine Craftidink stuck on a Servo without saving the house to the lot/library first; operator restored via reload. Never again — chat reminders do not bind.

rejected.why: Game Save As recovers the whole session; it is not the Build Mode building/room library revert the operator required, and prior thrash still skipped both.
Chat reminders do not bind host_stack or admit_mutation; another agent can still sledge walls.
Saving wreckage after deleting walls does not preserve the pre-mutation judgment.
Room/structure tools and wall/floor targets are never optional; soft exceptions invite the same failure.
Duplicates this owner; P124 keeps one library/structure admission surface.
Reload/rebuild is recovery after damage; prevention is fail-closed admission before mutation.

library_vs_save_as.library_checkpoint: Build Mode Save to My Library for the building/room blueprint — revert by placing from Library
library_vs_save_as.game_save_as: Session Save As under BI_TMP_/BI_CONT_ — still required for some destructive leases, never a substitute for library checkpoint
library_vs_save_as.operator_phrase_save_house_to_lot: Means SAVE_TO_LIBRARY (My Library building/lot blueprint) before structure mutate — not chat acknowledgment and not Save As alone

held_object_structure_blocks.operator_correction: Stuck Medicine Craftidink on Servo is cancel/select cleanup only — never sledge or delete floors/walls around it.

freshness_rule: library_checkpoint.model_revision MUST equal the current lot model revision at admit time; any later observe without a new library save invalidates the gate

success: if held object matches medicine_craftidink blocks -> CANCEL_UI only (deny structure effects)
if room/structure/FLOOR_2/stairs mutation planned and no fresh library_checkpoint -> plan/admit SAVE_TO_LIBRARY only
then spatial + integrity + optional Save As gates
optional live adapter ONLY after LIBRARY_ADMIT
observe outcome into same model (invalidates prior library checkpoint until re-saved)

violations.BUILDING_SCOPE_MISMATCH: Attestation building_id does not match mutation building_id
violations.LIBRARY_CAPTURE_MISSING: Attestation without capture_ref proving the library save UI outcome
violations.DELETE_FLOOR2_WITHOUT_LIBRARY_SAVE: FLOOR_2 / stairs / floor-tile delete or sledge without fresh library checkpoint
violations.STRUCTURE_WHILE_HELD_DISTRACTOR: Structure effect while Medicine Craftidink / crafty drink (or listed distractor) is held
violations.RAW_INPUT_BYPASS_OF_STRUCTURE_PREFLIGHT: Live SendInput of structure effects without admit_live_structure_effect
